_que_es: Browser speed parameters (keys stay in Spanish). 'objetivo' is the response-time target; 'carrera' is re-read by race.py on its own; the launcher passes 'navegador' to the browser when it opens.

tor._que_es: Tor entry: 'directo' (no bridge, the default here) or 'puente' (WebTunnel, needs ~/.smiley/bridges.sh with your own bridges). conflux_ux: 'throughput' or 'latency'. salida_paises / medio_paises: relay country codes (empty = any).
